checks: migrations apply in order and station migration reruns safely
only administrators manage stations; raw writes and credential-table access are denied
anonymous displays receive a short-lived pairing challenge, never raw stored credentials or employee metadata
pairing is station-bound and single-use; another station cannot reuse the browser credential
authorized displays issue branch-bound tokens that multiple authenticated employees can verify without changing attendance
lost-response retries and refresh recovery reuse one code; early rotations are rate-limited
tampering, wrong purpose/version, unauthorized branch, anonymous use and expired-code reuse fail
revoking a display immediately invalidates its credential and still-unexpired QR codes
stale management forms fail and invalid edits roll back device revocation with station changes
reactivating a station never resurrects revoked browser credentials
expired pairing codes cannot be authorized and a revoked browser can unpair itself
concurrent issuance is idempotent and moving branches revokes all displays with audit history
